snippet.title: (SOUL) SURVIVOR. | RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Play the game‼️: https://stephen-ddungu.itch.io/soul-survivor
Join the community discord‼️: https://discord.com/invite/Fg77ETueNq

➕No upgrades, no power-ups, just you & your blade in a race vs Death.

➕(SOUL) SURVIVOR. is a high-speed high-score hack & slash game solo-developed by Stephen Ddungu, 
(To assist the funding of his mainline projects, such as Sword Of Symphony, [][][][][] [][] [][𝑥][][][][][][][], etc. and also to 'test the waters' as their evenutal release draws closer).

➕ Will you survive until the end?
